num = 1

        num += 1
    bottom -= 1
    for i in range(bottom, top - 1, -1):
        matrix[i][left] = num
        num += 1
    left += 1
for row in matrix:
    print(___)
questions.solution:
n = 3
matrix = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
top, bottom, left, right = 0, n - 1, 0, n - 1
num = 1
while top <= bottom and left <= right:
    for j in range(left, right + 1):
        matrix[top][j] = num
        num += 1
    top += 1
    for i in range(top, bottom + 1):
        matrix[i][right] = num
        num += 1
    right -= 1
    for j in range(right, left - 1, -1):
        matrix[bottom][j] = num
        num += 1
    bottom -= 1
    for i in range(bottom, top - 1, -1):
        matrix[i][left] = num
        num += 1
    left += 1
for row in matrix:
    print(" ".join(f"{v:>2}" for v in row))

    chunk = text[i:i + 2]
    hex_part = " ".join(f"{ord(c):02x}" for c in chunk)
    ascii_part = "".join(c if c.isprintable() else "." for c in chunk)
    print(___)
questions.solution:
text = "Hello"
for i in range(0, len(text), 2):
    chunk = text[i:i + 2]
    hex_part = " ".join(f"{ord(c):02x}" for c in chunk)
    ascii_part = "".join(c if c.isprintable() else "." for c in chunk)

questions.description: 格式化输出 BMI 计算表。
questions.code_template:
print(f"{'Height':>8}{'Weight':>8}{'BMI':>8}{'Status':>10}")
for h, w in [(1.6, 50), (1.7, 65), (1.75, 80)]:
    bmi = w / h ** 2
